interpretation_limits: Primary aliases, broad Studio search and milestone23 are overlapping populations. Use their union once, or select a declared subset.
Discovery union includes adjacent repository work that mentions the Studio; inclusion does not assign all work on that record to the Studio.
GitHub search covers the current indexed title/body/comments and reported complete pages; deleted text, prior body revisions, unindexed recent edits and private work are outside this extract.
Current labels and milestones are observation-time memberships, not historical event labels. Bug is a label subset of Issues; label memberships overlap.
Elapsed issue/PR lifetime is a collaboration-record interval; it does not measure active work time, model runtime, or human/AI contribution share.
PR additions/deletions describe diffs against their bases. Promotion PRs and topic PRs can include the same changes, so their weights are not additive effort.
PR base/head branch names and merge SHAs are live GitHub metadata. Unmerged merge_commit_sha values may be test-merge candidates; use merged=true for accepted topology.
Zero discussion/inline-review comments does not establish absence of review; reviewed outcomes are also carried in PR bodies, Issues, local records and human collaboration.
Body reference edges are unclassified references, not inferred dependencies. Human-supported chapter groupings are editorial candidates.
The future main showcase endpoint remains open. Snapshot filters should be refreshed when the human selects the accepted final revision.

selected_evidence.summary: Records human approval of five concepts and their synthesis on 28 October 2026, the native rebuild direction, and the accepted main showcase on 5 November through PR #707.

Four review comments were treated as hypotheses. Bounded reviewers examined admission, accounting and complete-path cost; documentation and two targeted tests changed while runtime owners remained stable, with drafts and receiver measurement routed separately.

Records 240 declared measurement runs and the decision to keep full preparation with explicit Apply and live preview. These are application runtime observations, not human or AI productivity measures.

Preserves 60 source and 135 browser runs. Seven maximum-population accepted-render measurements missed original targets; human direction changed the next receiver to complete-showcase work while retaining the study and later refinement.

The connected chapter study shared people, teams, sessions and Undo. Cross-engine review found and repaired recovery and pointer-return issues; the human retained composition selection before production integration.
Preserving cassette, dial-lighting and lane specimens coincided with a review repair to a field-settlement interaction that could consume the next Add click.

VHS-C geometry, internal grip texture, connected budget composition and scale-specific money controls were reviewed together with keyboard focus, fixed readout geometry and independent comparison copies.

Human approved a main-branch reference promotion preserving approved workbench art at 93bc69a, while About runtime remained byte-identical to 9338acc. Future showcase integration and main promotion retained separate decisions.

Human approval expanded the earlier staged one-type exploration into full five-deck adoption. Stable identities, independent assumptions, canonical cost separation and proportional checks remain explicit.
Four People compositions were compared; the selected synthesis combined editorial team lanes, direct participation matrix and one focused receiver.
Closed not planned after the human clarified the showcase's role in gauging undertakings; funding-category clarity moved to the editorial export and tests now target consequential meaning.
